annotations.title: List company legal forms and State fees

description: List the main legal forms to create a company in Algeria: SARL, EURL, SPA, SPAS and SPASU (the simplified joint-stock company of loi 22-09, reserved to companies certified start-up), SNC, sole trader and auto-entrepreneur. Other forms of the commercial code (sociétés en commandite, groupement, société en participation) are not in this list, so never say a form does not exist because it is missing here: check search_jo_text. For each form it gives the number of partners allowed, the minimum capital and the official State fees of each creation step (trade register, legal announcements and so on) for 2026, with the total of the published fees. A step whose price no official text fixes, such as the notary or the bank, is flagged as not priced instead of guessed. It lists State fees only, never the fees of a service provider, so it is not a quote for a creation. For Tunisia (country TN) it lists the legal forms of the commercial companies code (SARL, SUARL, SA, SNC, SCS) and the sole trader, with the partners allowed, the minimum capital, the liability and the registration steps at the National Register of Enterprises, each with its official fee in Tunisian dinars, its documents and its delay. For Morocco (country MA) it lists the SARL, the single-member SARL (SARL AU), the SA, the SAS, the SNC and the SCS, the sole trader and the auto-entrepreneur status, with the partners allowed, the minimum capital, the liability and the creation steps (negative certificate of OMPIC, statutes, registration of the deeds, professional tax and tax identification, trade register, CNSS affiliation, publication in the official gazette), each with its official fee in Moroccan dirhams when an official page states one. Tunisia and Morocco need an API key.

country.description: Country of the data, an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in any letter case: DZ for Algeria, the default, TN for Tunisia or MA for Morocco. Only live countries answer: list_countries shows them and their datasets. Any other country, or a dataset the country does not have (for example the activity nomenclature for Morocco), returns country_not_available. Without an API key only DZ answers: TN and MA return key_required.

lang.description: Language of the labels, notes and attribution text in the answer: fr (French, the default), ar (Arabic) or en (English).
